title: Bypassing Controls via Production Testing Endpoints
pattern: Hardcoding test modes, validation bypass flags, or mock parameters directly into production binary codebases to simplify staging or manual tests.
why_bad: If an attacker triggers the test mode flag (e.g. via setting specific environment parameters or headers), they can completely bypass authentication checks and access restricted production resources.
detection: Conditional blocks (`if test_mode`) inside security-sensitive code branches that bypass authorization/authentication logic.
fix: Isolate testing code into separate test configurations that are completely compiled out of production releases (`#[cfg(test)]` attributes).
source: `Heather Adkins et al. - Building Secure and Reliable Systems (2020)`, Ch 5, p. 71-72.
